description: This file contains an implementation of the PBKDF2 key derivation function using HMAC, part of the OpenSSL cryptographic library. It includes cryptographic functions, licensing information, and dependencies on OpenSSL headers.

methods.name: PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC
methods.description: Implements PBKDF2 key derivation using HMAC with specified digest, salt, iterations, and output key length.

methods.name: PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC_SHA1
methods.description: Convenience function for PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA1.
